title: Aao Abbas ab chale aao
body:
AAO ABBAS AB CHALE AAO, AAO ABBAS AB CHALE AAO
AB LAYEE’N SAR SE CHHEENTE HAIN RIDA, AAO ABBAS AB CHALE AAO
Apne noor-e-nazar fida karke
Maine haq ko adaa kiya aise
Haal dilka batau’n mai kaise
Mujhko pursa do aake baccho ka
<<MINI>>
Roke Zainab ne dasht mein ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Tashnalab bezuba’n Ali Asgher
Khaake bejurm teer gardan par
Chal basa run mein bano ka dilbar
Uska qaime mein jalgaya jhoola
<<MINI>>
Roke Zainab ne dasht mein ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Haal kya ho bayaan Qasim ka
Jiska pal mein bikhar gaya sehra
Haye kaise ujad gayi duniya
Bain kisse kare bhala kubra
<<MINI>>
Roke Zainab ne dasht mein ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Noujawa’n hum shabehe Paighambar
Tha badan jiska jalti reti par
Muztarib hoke rote the Sarwar
Gham se marjaye na kahin Laila
<<MINI>>
Roke Zainab ne dasht mein ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Aao Imdaad ko mere saqqa
Sote ho chain se lab-e-dariya
Ab nigehbaa’n hai kaun bewo’n ka
Sabka dushwaar hogaya jeena
<<MINI>>
Roke Zainab ne dasht mein ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Bain karti hai ye Sakina jaa’n
Aao ammu mere gaye ho kahan
Maarte hain tamache be-imaa’n
Kya gawara hai ye tumhe bhaiya
<<MINI>>
Roke Zainab ne dasht mein ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekho Abid ka haal-e-zaar utho
Kis qadar hai ye beqaraar utho
Pehne hain tauq-e-khaardaar utho
Zulm uspar hai har qadam pa naya
<<MINI>>
Roke Zainab ne dasht mein ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Lut gaya ghar huwe aseer haram
Peet ke sar ko karte the matam
Thi labo’n par fughaa’n yahi paiham
Ab nahin koi poochne wala
<<MINI>>
Roke Zainab ne dasht mein ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Taziyano’n ki hai jafa hum par
Shaad hote hain ispa ahl-e-shar
Sharm se jhuk rahi hai meri nazar
Inteha ko pohonch gayi eiza
<<MINI>>
Roke Zainab ne dasht mein ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Nargha-e-zulm mein hai Sibt-e-Nabi
Kabhi patthar laga kabhi barchhi
Kis qadar Shai pa ab hai tanhayi
Zer-e-khanjar tadapta hai laasha
<<MINI>>
Roke Zainab ne dasht mein ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye darbar-e-shaam ka manzar
Kargaya zakhm wo mere dil par
Pesh-e-hakim thi Aal-e-Paighambar
Hai rasan mein gala Sakina ka
<<MINI>>
Roke Zainab ne dasht mein ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Gham mein Sarwar ke jo kare matam
Degi Zehra dua unhe paiham
Zeest apni to hai unhi ka gham
Taba mehshar Sohail ho ye sada
